name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, joined Awin Feeds, and approved eBay listings; find verified deals and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.10.4 separates exact-product requests from category discovery: named-product identity anchors are preserved, conflicting apparel types are rejected, unrelated products never pad the top three, and alternatives appear only when explicitly requested. Requested products and alternatives render in separate card groups, while ranking prioritizes identity, specification fit, merchant quality, availability, verified deals, and price. The private Awin Feed List discovers joined US English Feeds, Shopify Global Catalog remains the general catalog source, and approved eBay listings remain opt-in. Node.js 24, stable product selection, bounded provider normalization, fail-closed schema handling, and neutral affiliate ranking remain in place. Authorized Chrome remains a bounded fallback after complete API search returns no usable product. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
